G1800.def: of Hebrew origin («0583»); Enos (i.e. Enosh), a patriarch:--Enos.

G1801.et: middle voice from a compound of (1722) and (3775)
G1801.def: middle voice from a compound of «1722» and «3775»; to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen:--hearken.

G1802.def: of Hebrew origin («02585»); Enoch (i.e. Chanok), an antediluvian:--Enoch.

G1804.def: from «1537» and the base of «32»; to publish, i.e. celebrate:--shew forth.

G1805.def: from «1537» and «59»; to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity):--redeem.

G1806.def: from «1537» and «71»; to lead forth:--bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.

G1807.def: from «1537» and «138»; actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release:--deliver, pluck out, rescue.

G1809.def: middle voice from «1537» and «154»; to demand (for trial):--desire.

G1810.def: from «1537» and the base of «160»; of a sudden (unexpectedly):--suddenly. Compare «1819».

G1811.def: from «1537» and «190»; to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to:--follow.

G1812.def: plural ordinal from «1803» and «1540»; six hundred:--six hundred.

G1813.def: from «1537» and «218»; to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin):--blot out, wipe away.

G1814.def: from «1537» and «242»; to spring forth :--leap up.

G1816.def: from «1537» and «393»; to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate:--spring up.

G1817.def: from «1537» and «450»; objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object:--raise (rise) up.

G1818.def: from «1537» and «538»; to seduce wholly:--beguile, deceive.

G1819.et: from (1537) and a derivative of the same as (160)
G1819.def: from «1537» and a derivative of the same as «160»; of a sudden, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly. Compare «1810».

G1820.def: middle voice from «1537» and «639»; to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond:--(in) despair.

G1821.def: from «1537» and «649»; to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss:--send (away, forth, out).

G1822.def: from «1537» and a derivative of «739»; to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher):--accomplish, thoroughly furnish.

G1823.def: from «1537» and «797»; to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments):--glistening.

G1824.et: from (1537) and the genitive case singular feminine of (846) ((5610) being understood)
G1824.def: from «1537» and the genitive case singular feminine of «846» (5610 being understood); from that hour, i.e. instantly:--by and by, immediately, presently, straightway.

G1825.def: from «1537» and «1453»; to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction):--raise up.

G1826.def: from «1537» and eimi (to go); to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore):--depart, get (to land), go out.

G1827.def: from «1537» and «1651»; to convict fully, i.e. (by implication) to punish:--convince.

G1828.def: from «1537» and «1670»; to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin):--draw away.

G1829.et: from a comparative of (1537) and a presumed erao (to spue)
G1829.def: from a comparative of «1537» and a presumed erao (to spue); vomit, i.e. food disgorged:--vomit.

G1831.def: from «1537» and «2064»; to issue (literally or figuratively):--come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.

G1832.et: third person singular present indicative of a compound of (1537) and (1510)
G1832.def: third person singular present indicative of a compound of «1537» and «1510»; so also exon ex-on' neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of «1510» expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public):--be lawful, let, × may(-est).

G1833.def: from «1537» and etazo (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate:--ask, enquire, search.

G1834.def: from «1537» and «2233»; to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold:--declare, tell.

G1835.def: the tenth multiple of «1803»; sixty:--sixty(-fold), threescore.

G1836.et: from (2192) (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining)
G1836.def: from «2192» (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); successive:--after, following, × morrow, next.

G1837.def: middle voice from «1537» and «2278»; to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported):--sound forth.

G1839.def: from «1537» and «2476»; to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane:--amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.

G1840.def: from «1537» and «2480»; to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent:--be able.

G1841.def: from «1537» and «3598»; an exit, i.e. (figuratively) death:--decease, departing.

G1843.def: from «1537» and «3670»; to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully:--confess, profess, promise.

G1844.def: from «1537» and «3726»; to exact an oath, i.e. conjure:--adjure.

G1845.def: from «1844»; one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer):--exorcist.

G1846.def: from «1537» and «3736»; to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing):--break up, pluck out.

G1847.et: from (1537) and a derivative of the neuter of (3762)
G1847.def: from «1537» and a derivative of the neuter of «3762»; to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise:--set at nought. See also «1848».

G1848.def: a variation of «1847» and meaning the same:--contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.

G1849.def: from «1832» (in the sense of ability); privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence:--authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.

G1850.def: from «1849»; to control:--exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.

G1851.et: from a compound of (1537) and (2192) (meaning to stand out)
G1851.def: from a compound of «1537» and «2192» (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively):--principal.

G1852.def: from «1853»; to waken:--awake out of sleep.

G1853.def: from «1537» and «5258»; awake:--X out of sleep.

G1854.def: adverb from «1537»; out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively:--away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange.

G1856.def: from «1537» and otheo (to push); to expel; by implication, to propel:--drive out, thrust in.

G1858.def: from «1859»; to observe a festival:--keep the feast.

G1859.def: of uncertain affinity; a festival:--feast, holyday.

G1860.def: from «1861»; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good):--message, promise.

G1861.def: from «1909» and the base of «32»; to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself:--profess, (make) promise.

G1862.def: from «1861»; a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good):--promise.

G1863.def: from «1909» and «71»; to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime):--bring upon.

G1864.def: from «1909» and «75»; to struggle for:--earnestly contend foreign

G1865.def: from «1909» and athroizo (to assemble); to accumulate:--gather thick together.

G1867.def: from «1909» and «134»; to applaud:--commend, laud, praise.

G1868.def: from «1909» and the base of «134»; laudation; concretely, a commendable thing:--praise.

G1869.def: from «1909» and «142»; to raise up (literally or figuratively):--exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.

G1870.def: from «1909» and «153»; to feel shame for something:--be ashamed.

G1874.def: from «1909» and the base of «202»; to listen (intently) to:--hear.

G1875.def: from «1909» and «302»; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as:--when.

G1876.et: from a presumed compound of (1909) and (318)
G1876.def: neuter of a presumed compound of «1909» and «318»; (adverbially) on necessity, i.e. necessarily:--necessary.

G1877.def: from «1909» and «321»; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return:--launch (thrust) out, return.

G1878.def: from «1909» and «363»; to remind of:--put in mind.

G1879.def: middle voice from «1909» and «373»; to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely):--rest in (upon).

G1880.def: from «1909» and «424»; to come up on, i.e. return:--come again, return.

G1881.def: middle voice from «1909» and «450»; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack:--rise up against.

G1882.def: from a compound of «1909» and «461»; a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation):-- correction.

G1883.def: from «1909» and «507»; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.):--above, more than, (up-)on, over.

G1884.def: from «1909» and «714»; to avail for, i.e. help:--relieve.

G1885.et: from a compound of (1909) and (757) (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch")
G1885.def: from a compound of «1909» and «757» (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch"); a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture:--province.

G1886.def: from «1909» and an equivalent of «833»; a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling:--habitation.

G1887.def: from «1909» and «839»; occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (2250 being implied) to-morrow:--day following, morrow, next day (after).

G1888.et: from (1909) and (846) and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of phor (a thief)
G1888.def: from «1909» and «846» and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of phor (a thief); in theft itself, i.e. (by analogy) in actual crime:--in the very act.

G1890.def: from «1909» and «875»; to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion):--foam out.

G1891.et: from (1909) (in the sense of devoted to) and Aphrodite (Venus)
G1891.def: from «1909» (in the sense of devoted to) and Aphrodite (Venus); Epaphroditus, a Christian:--Epaphroditus. Compare «1889».

G1892.def: from «1909» and «1453»; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against:--raise, stir up.

G1893.def: from «1909» and «1487»; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.

G1894.def: from «1893» and «1211»; since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas:--after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

G1896.et: and other moods and persons of the same tense, from (1909) and (1492)
G1896.def: and other moods and persons of the same tense; from «1909» and «1492»; to regard (favorably or otherwise):--behold, look upon.

G1898.def: from a compound of «1909» and «1521»; a superintroduction:--bringing in.
